title: Charts modeled on the sharp characteristic of a log regular scheme
statement: Let $(X,M,\alpha)$ be a locally Noetherian log regular fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $\bar x$ be a geometric point above $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and put $P=\overline M_{\bar x}$. Then $P$ is a finitely generated integral saturated sharp monoid (sharp means that $0$ is its only invertible element), and there is a pointed etale neighbourhood $(W,\bar w)\to(X,\bar x)$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] with a chart $P\to M|_W$ whose induced map $P\to\overline M_{\bar w}$ is the chosen identification with $P$. The chart may be taken on an affine locally Noetherian $W$.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.6, printed p. 70: P is fs sharp and X admits a chart modeled on P at the geometric point (before the completed-local-ring formulas).
